title: Flanged bushing for an 8 mm rod
prompt: Flanged bushing for an 8 mm rod, to be turned from Delrin: 8.1 mm bore, 12 mm outside diameter, 15 mm long overall including an 18 mm diameter, 2 mm thick flange at one end.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
18 mm flange diameter, 15 mm long, ±0.1 mm
Three cylindrical faces: bore, body and flange rim
Three flat faces: both ends and the flange shoulder
